Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.combat

Class Hitbox

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.combat.Hitbox
All Implemented Interfaces:
Updatable
public final class Hitbox extends Object implements Updatable
The area of an attack that deals damage (GDD 1.5): a melee swing, a projectile, a trap or a contact attack. It hits a Damageable whose hurtbox it overlaps, never its owner, and each target only once during its lifetime. It only answers whether it can hit; the owner applies the damage.

Its shape is always an Obb: one that turns for a melee swing, Obb.around(com.epitech.depthdiablo.geometry.Aabb) a box for the attacks that never turn.

  • Constructor Details

    • Hitbox

      public Hitbox(Obb shape, Entity owner, Faction faction, int lifetimeTicks)
      Creates a hitbox.
      Parameters:
      shape - the area it covers in the world
      owner - the entity whose attack it is; it never hits its owner
      faction - the side the attack fights for, taken when the attack starts; a target of a side it cannot hurt is never hit
      lifetimeTicks - how many logic ticks it lasts (60 per second, Q42); above 0
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if shape, owner or faction is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if lifetimeTicks is 0 or less

    • canHit

      public boolean canHit(Damageable target)
      Tells whether this hitbox can hit the target now (GDD 1.5): it is not expired, the target is not its owner, its faction can hurt the target's, it did not land a hit on the target yet, the target is alive, and its hurtbox overlaps this hitbox's shape. It changes nothing: the owner hits, then calls recordHit(com.epitech.depthdiablo.combat.Damageable, com.epitech.depthdiablo.combat.HitResult).
      Parameters:
      target - the one that could be hit
      Returns:
      true if the target can be hit now
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if target is null

    • recordHit

      public void recordHit(Damageable target, HitResult result)
      Records the result of a hit on the target. A hit that landed marks the target, so this hitbox never hits it again during its lifetime. A hit that did not land (the target was invincible) does not count: the same attack can still hit it once its invincibility ends. A new attack creates a new hitbox, which can hit the same target again.
      Parameters:
      target - the one that was hit
      result - what the hit did
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if target or result is null

    • reshape

      public void reshape(Obb newShape)
      Replaces the area this hitbox covers, for an attack that moves or turns: a melee swing sweeping towards the end of its arc, or a projectile in flight. The targets it already hit and its ticks left stay the same, so a swing never hits the same target twice.
      Parameters:
      newShape - the area it covers from now on
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if newShape is null
